audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave every one of the seven rows to Zaahen, while the packet levelChart marks Level 1 and Level 6 as Skill, and the already-audited mirror set those same two rows to Skill.
audit.why: Level 1 Zaahen has only his Q double-slash and no gap-close, so Inner Flame (950 range, projectile) trades on Karma's terms. At Level 6 Zaahen gains R but Mantra has been available since level 1, so the level itself does not swing the lane.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 4 set to Skill on both layers, with ratings moved to 5/10 so the rating does not contradict the side.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text claimed 'her R is passive Mantra charges' and treated level 6 as a shield/root spike.
audit.why: Riot's text: Mantra empowers her next ability, is available at level 1, and requires no skill point; cooldown 40/38/36/34 and Gathering Fire reduces it on damaging ability hits. It is an active, not a passive charge system, and it is not a level-6 event.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[1].text around Mantra's real 40s cooldown and passive refund, and made Zaahen's R (110s at rank 1, heals for a portion of damage dealt) the actual level-6 spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Focused Resolve is a tether that only roots if it survives, and Zaahen's E is a dash. 'RE-empowered W' also mislabels Mantra (R) empowering W.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is a 675-range tether on a flat 12s cooldown at every rank; Riot's text says the enemy is rooted only if the tether is not broken. Zaahen's E dashes to a location on 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, which is the cleanest tether-break in the matchup. Mantra W additionally heals Karma and extends the root.
audit.corrected: Stated the tether-break explicitly with the 675 range and the E cooldown, corrected the Mantra labelling, and recorded the Grievous Wounds requirement against Mantra-W healing.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried placeholder text with no numbers.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is 12s at every rank — the flat cooldown means the punish window never shortens as she levels it.
audit.corrected: Wrote the 12s figure, the tether break, the anti-heal note and Zaahen's 110s R into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal guidance despite Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve healing Karma through chip.
audit.why: Flagged by _missing as needs-antiheal for this exact matchup.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds requirement added to breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: Karma top leans on Q (Inner Flame) poke and the shield/speed of RE-empowered W (Focused Resolve) to root you, but she's a squishy caster with no dash: dodge her skillshot Q, walk her down, and Q (Darkin Glaive) plus autos out-trade her every exchange. Her mana drains fast if she spams poke.
edits.after: Karma top leans on Inner Flame (Q) poke, a 950-range projectile on 9s at rank 1, and Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve (W) to root you. The tether only roots if it survives: leave her 675 range and it breaks. Dodge the Q, walk her down behind minions, and your Q double-slash plus autos out-trade her.

edits.before: Karma has no ultimate power spike at 6 (her R is passive Mantra charges), so while she gets an empowered W root and shield, you still out-duel her; save your E (Golden Onslaught) to close after she uses W. Watch the RW root, it can peel a gank.
edits.after: Karma has no level-6 spike: Mantra costs no point and has been up since level 1 on 40s, refunded by every damaging ability she lands. Your R is the real spike — it heals for part of the damage dealt, so commit it once her W tether is broken, never into it.

edits.before: Level 6 is close because Karma gains no ult spike, but her empowered W root can still peel.
edits.after: Level 6 is close: Mantra was up from level 1, so her one new tool is banking it for the W root.

edits.before: Bait her empowered W (Focused Resolve) root, then E (Golden Onslaught) in
edits.after: Bait her Focused Resolve tether, then break it by dashing out with E

edits.before: Root you with RW (Focused Resolve) to kite and disengage
edits.after: Root you with Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve to disengage

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Focused Resolve: 12s flat at every rank — her only lockdown, and the tether breaks if you leave her 675 range. - Mantra W heals her too: buy Grievous Wounds before extended fights. - Your R: 110s at rank 1 — kill windows only.

edits.before: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: The tether roots only if it survives — dash out of her 675 range and it breaks harmlessly.

notes: Zaahen's kit file carries no ability names, only slots. The content layer named his Q 'Darkin Glaive' and his E 'Golden Onslaught'; the mirror audit used 'The Darkin Glaive' and 'Aureate Rush' for the same slots. Both are unverifiable from the kits, so I removed the names rather than pick a side, and referred to slots. Karma's W cooldown is a flat 12 at all ranks in the kit file.
